name: charge_gather
for: hero (wayfarer) charged heavy attack: loops while the heavy button is held at the top of the heavy wind-up (wayfarer_ne/heavy frame 006), up to 1 s
anchor_note: anchor_px = the core; place it on the hero's hands/hilt at the top of the wind-up (in wayfarer_ne/heavy/006.png the hands are at about (110,52) of the 168x168 frame)
notes: Ten thin 1-px streaks of warm light pulled inward from all round (about 1.2 m across at 64 px/m), dim amber at the outer end brightening to white as they accelerate into the core, plus five 1-px sparks; a small hard white core with a short 4+4 ray cross that throbs twice per loop (0.83 s). Mostly open space, 7 colours, no outline, no dither. Hand-placed streak paths (shape layers), each cycling once per loop, so it loops seamlessly.
